visual_action: The video first shows a split-screen image of Donald Trump speaking outdoors. Yellow text captions his words. It then cuts to a screenshot of a tweet from the 'Democrats' Twitter account. The tweet asks, "So then why the fuck did you get us involved?" in response to a quoted tweet from CSPAN which features a quote from President Trump about Israel and Iran.

on_screen_text.text: We have two countries that have been fighting so long...
...that they don't know what the fuck they're doing.
So then why the fuck did you get us involved?
President Trump on Israel and Iran: "We basically have two countries that have been fighting so long and so hard that they don't know what the fuck they're doing."

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video. The on-screen text attributes a quote to Donald Trump, but he is not heard saying it. The only audio is a music track.
audio_music: An upbeat, funky instrumental track with brass and percussion, featuring vocal ad-libs like 'oh!', plays throughout the entire video. The energetic music creates a mocking or 'gotcha' tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of two static images presented as a slideshow: a split-screen photo of Donald Trump, followed by a screenshot of a tweet. The transition is a simple cut.
central_claim: Donald Trump is hypocritical for getting the U.S. involved in a foreign conflict that he himself describes as pointless.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as incompetent and hypocritical regarding foreign policy.
